row.text:
It was a sunny day and two friends, Jake and Lucy, were playing in the park. They saw something in the water. It was a big otter! Jake wanted to get closer and pushed the otter with his foot. Suddenly, the otter jumped up and it scared Lucy. The otter was so sleepy and it did not want to move. Jake and Lucy watched it and they thought it was so fun. 

Soon, the otter started to move again and it swam away. Jake and Lucy waved goodbye and then they started running back to the park on the other side of the lake. They chased each other until they were both very tired. Then, they sat down together and laughed about the sleepy otter. 

Jake and Lucy had a wonderful day!

Dad was at the market. He heard a voice from behind him asking, "Please, can I have some beef?" Dad turned around and saw a little girl. She had big eyes and long hair.

Dad said, "Yes, of course." He handed the girl some beef.

The girl thanked Dad. She said, "Thank you so much. Now I feel safe and full." 

Dad smiled. He said, "You're welcome. Please make sure to always request help if you need it."

Once upon a time, there was a wealthy gorilla living in the jungle. One day, the jungle caught fire and the gorilla was in big trouble. He couldn't put the fire out by himself. He started to worry.

Just then, a brave boy saw the gorilla in trouble and decided to help save him. He found a big bucket and filled it with water from a nearby river. He ran back to the fire and started to pour the water on it.

The boy kept pouring water until the fire went away. The gorilla was so relieved and thanked the boy for saving his home. The boy smiled and said he was glad he could help. The gorilla gave him a big hug and the boy went back home.

The boy and the gorilla became the best of friends and whenever the gorilla was in trouble, the boy would come and help save him. They were a great team and everyone who saw them was very happy.

Once upon a time, there was a bird. The bird was very special because it could soar like no other. It was so brave and so free, it had to see the world!

So off it went, soaring through the clouds and up into the sky. It saw so many beautiful places and made lots of new memories.

But then one day, something strange happened. The bird's wings started to feel heavy and it could no longer fly. It was so lonely and scared; it wanted to go home but didn't know where that was.

But then, a little voice from its memories reminded it, "Just keep going and never give up, then you will make it home".

So with all its strength, the brave bird flew onwards, and eventually it found its way home. It flew up high and spread its wings wide, soaring in the sky! It was so happy to be home again, and never forgot the little voice that helped guide its way.

Once upon a time there was a mighty bow. It was so big and powerful, it made everyone smile when they saw it.

One day, a small boy named John wanted to play with the bow. He asked his mom if he could have it, and she said yes!

John was so excited, he ran to his room and started to attach the bow to his wall. He wanted everyone in his family to see it.

He worked hard and soon, it was all attached and ready. Everyone was so amazed and proud to see it. John was proud of his work too!

Every day, the bow spread its mighty power. No one else in the world had a bow like John's. It was beautiful and made the world feel special.

Once upon a time there were two friends, John and Bob. John was sad because he had no one to play with. Suddenly, he heard a sound from the sky above. It was a dove! The dove looked at John and came closer. John was so happy that the dove had come to play. 

John and Bob started playing together. They had so much fun! But then, John began to worry. How could he keep the dove from flying away and take it home with him? He tried so hard to think of a way, but nothing worked. 

Just then, the dove came close and said something magical. "My friend, if you give me something special, I can stay and unite with you forever." 

John and Bob worked together to find something special. They ran around and looked hard until they found a bright blue feather. The dove was so happy! When the feather was placed around her neck, the dove and John were united as one. Together they flew home happy ever after.

Once upon a time, there was a boy. He was very curious and wanted to find out what was in the cupboard. He walked over to it and opened the door. He was so surprised when he saw what was inside!

The cupboard was full of toys. He found a teddy bear, a doll, a truck, and lots of other fun things. He was so happy! He grabbed the teddy bear and started playing with it.

But then the boy noticed something strange. There was something stuck inside the cupboard. He could not get it out no matter how hard he tried. He became frustrated and tried to pull it out again and again.

But the boy soon realized he could not open the cupboard without a key. He looked all over the house, but he could not find the key anywhere. 

He became even more frustrated and sat down in a sulk. Suddenly he remembered where he had seen the key before. The key was with his mom! He quickly ran to her and asked her for the key. 

She smiled and gave him the key with a surprise. The boy was so excited and quickly ran back to the cupboard with the key. He unlocked the cupboard and opened the door with a smile. 

Inside, he found a secret present only for him! He was so happy and could not believe it. It was a perfect ending to his adventure. What a

There was a little girl called Lucy who went to school. It made Lucy feel safe and happy. Every morning, she would put on her new red schoolbag and walk to school with her mummy. At school, Lucy would learn lots of new things and feel very proud of herself.

At the end of the day, Lucy and her mummy would pick an apple from the fruit stand and take it home with them. Lucy would take a big bite and say "yummy"!

But one day, the apple wasn't so yummy. It had started to rot and it smelled bad. Lucy's mummy said the apple wasn't safe to eat anymore. Lucy felt sad but understood why her mummy was protecting her. From that day on, Lucy always checked her apples before taking a big bite!

Once upon a time, there was a little girl who had a terrific problem. She had no money to buy the things that she wanted, and it made her feel very troubled.

One day, her dad came to visit her and gave her a big surprise. He gave her a pile of money and said it was just for her! She was so happy that she jumped up and down with delight.

With the money, she thought of all the fun things that she could buy for herself. But before she had a chance to spend it, something horrible happened. A spark from the fireplace flew out and set the money on fire. The money was burning!

The little girl started to cry because all of her money was gone. Even though she was very disappointed, she knew that the money couldn't buy everything. She had to find another way to get the things she wanted.

Nina was so excited to go shopping with her mom. Her mom said she could have a new toy if she was good. As she was walking through the store, she saw a really nice toy, but it was too expensive for her pocket. Her mom said it was too expensive so they had to keep looking.

But then Nina spotted an even better toy - it was cheap! She was so excited she grabbed it and put it in her pocket. Her mom didn't see, but when they got home and her mom noticed, she was very mad. She said it was wrong to take something without asking.

Nina knew she was in trouble, and her mom had to punish her. She was very sad, but knew she had been wrong. From now on, she promised to be a good girl and always ask before she took anything.

Once there was a little girl called Jacky. She was 3 years old and wanted to do something very special. She wanted to create something impressive. So Jacky asked her mom what she could do. Her mom said that she could separate her fingers. Jacky was excited!

Jacky took both her hands and held them closely together. She looked closely at her fingers and tried to separate them. She pushed and pulled on them. But it was hard work! After a few tries, Jacky finally managed to separate her fingers. She was so proud for doing something so impressive.

Jacky was glad she could do something so special. She showed her mom and dad her fingers and they both said it was amazing. Jacky smiled from ear to ear and was so happy that she could separate her fingers. She felt really proud and now knew she could do something amazing.

Once there was a girl called Anna who liked to watch videos. She enjoyed them every day.

One day Anna saw a video with a poor man. He looked sad and lonely. Anna wanted to help him.

She went to find him and lead him to her house. When he arrived, Anna showed him all the videos she had. 

The poor man smiled for the first time in a long time. He was so happy to have a friend who cared.

Every day, Anna would lead the poor man to her house and they would watch videos together. 

Anna and the poor man became the best of friends. They had lots of fun watching videos and spending time together.

Once upon a time there was a little baby fox. He was very hungry, so he went looking for food. He dug through the leaves on the forest floor, but he couldn't find anything. He was getting very upset and started to worry.

Then, he heard a noise in the treetops. He looked up and saw a big, red bird. The bird was carrying a big, juicy worm in his beak! The fox got very excited and howled. The bird heard him, and dropped the worm so the fox could feed.

The fox gobbled up the juicy worm, feeling much better. He thanked the bird for the food and went off on his way. He left the forest feeling happy and full.

Once upon a time, there was a mystery that nobody could figure out. Everyone was so ignorant about it because no one had tested it before. So one day, a brave little three year old decided to try to uncover the mystery. He tested the mystery by looking at it, poking it, and shaking it. But no matter what he tried, he couldn't figure it out. In the end, he just gave up and went home, still entirely ignorant of the mystery's secret. Sadly, the mystery was never solved.

One day, little Joe decided to wander around the house. He went up and down the stairs, looking at things. Eventually he made his way to the roof.

The roof was big and wide and Joe felt so happy. He could start to see things from a whole new perspective up there. He wanted to explore the roof, so he started to wander around.

Suddenly he heard a loud, rude voice. Joe turned around and was surprised to see a big, tall man. The man was not happy to see Joe and he demanded that he left immediately.

So Joe quickly ran back down the staircase and did not come back to the roof for a long time after that. The roof remained a mysterious place for him, but he wanted to explore it again one day.

Once upon a time there was a lucky little boy. His name was Tim. He had a special mirror. It was so shiny and sparkly. One day, Tim was playing with it. He took it outside to get a better look. Suddenly, he slipped and the mirror fell to the ground. It broke into a million pieces.

Tim was very sad. He wanted to make the mirror look like new. But he didn't know what to do. He asked his mom for help. She told him to take out the tool box and find the sharp knife.

Tim took out the knife and began cutting the mirror into small pieces. He worked very hard and in the end, the mirror looked just like it was before. Tim was very happy and he soon hugged the mirror.

"Thank you," he said. "I'm so lucky to have this mirror back."

Once there was a little fish who lived in the sea. He was having a very nice day and was swimming around looking for food, when suddenly he saw a hook! He was so scared, he quickly hid behind a rock.

The fish was very uncomfortable. He wanted to stay away from the hook, but he was also very curious. He wanted to know what it was. So he decided to move a little closer to take a look.

He moved slowly and carefully towards the hook, and he could see that it was there to catch fish. He had to find a way to stay away and stay safe. So the fish had an idea. He saw that there were some weeds near the hook. He swam over and hid underneath them.

Now the fish felt much more comfortable. He was hidden underneath the weeds, and he could stay away from the hook. He was safe and happy now.

Once upon a time, there was a girl who could balance. She wanted to balance on the moon. So she climbed high, higher and highest until she reached the Moon. But it was hard! The moon was shiny and the air was harsh.

She tried to balance on the Moon. But it was bumpy and it wobbled. She tried again and again, but she could not make it.

So she asked the Moon for help. Suddenly, the Moon felt sorry for her and became very gentle and smooth. Now the girl could balance on the moon easily.

She could balance up and down, side to side and around and around. She was very happy! She made the Moon her playground.

Jimmy was a small boy. He loved to mix things.

He went to the kitchen and took a bowl with him. His mom had a big kitchen with a small stove.

Jimmy wanted to mix some things to make a cake. So he put some ingredients in the bowl. He added flour and sugar. Then he mixed them all together.

Next, Jimmy put the bowl on the small stove. He turned the stove on and waited. Then something magical happened - his mixture began to bake into a cake. Jimmy was so excited!

When the cake was ready, Jimmy smiled and took it out of the stove. It smelled delicious. Now Jimmy had a yummy cake to eat!

John was ready. He put on his coat and hat and went to the post office. He wanted to mail something special. He picked up a bag and carefully put a lollipop inside. Then he took it to the counter at the post office and the lady there helped him to mail it.

John couldn't wait to get the lollipop back. He kept asking when it would return. Every day he checked the mailbox and waited.

Finally one day, John was ready again and was so happy when he ran to the mailbox and saw the lollipop there. He quickly picked it up, smiled and thanked the postman. Comfortably eating his lollipop, John happily went home.

Once upon a time, there was a bright window. The window was in a house and it was so pretty. The window was almost too big to fit in the wall! 

One day, a little bunny hopped over to the window. He hopped and hopped and came close enough to the window to take a peek inside. The window opened and the bunny hopped into the room. He couldn't believe his eyes! 

Inside, there were all sorts of colors everywhere. Bright blue, yellow, and red were everywhere. He had never seen so many colors in one place before! He hopped around and explored, discovering all the colors. 

The bunny was so happy to find such a bright and fun place and he knew he would never forget it. He hopped out of the window and went back to his home, with the colors still on his mind. He would remember it forever, the bright window full of colors.

Once there was a lovely mother. She was always so happy and kind. Every day she made something special happen.

One day mother said "Let's take a walk outside." So they went to the park together. The sun was shining and it was so nice.

The mother and the little one laughed and played in the park. They ran and jumped and hugged. Mother said "You make me so happy."

Afterwards, they lay in the grass on their backs and watched the clouds. Mother said "I love you so much." The little one smiled. It was a lovely day.

The mother said, "Let's go home now and have dinner." The little one said "Yes, let's go home." So they went home together, holding hands. It was a lovely day with a lovely mother, full of love.

Sadie was feeling angry. Her doll was lost and she couldn't find it anywhere.

Sadie crept into the hall and called out for her doll. She looked under all the chairs and behind the curtains but still nothing.

Sadie sat down on the floor and began to cry. The hall felt very quiet.

Suddenly, Sadie had an idea. She clasped her hands together, closed her eyes and began to pray. 

She prayed that her doll would come back to her so that she could be happy again. 

Sadie waited for a few minutes before opening her eyes. She looked around and to her surprise, her doll was right there!

Sadie was so happy and hugged her doll tightly. She thanked God for hearing her prayers and returned home with a smile on her face.

Once there was a boy who had a difficult time in the classroom. He was always forgetting things, and he had trouble listening to the teacher. One day he got to school and realized he had lost his pencil. He was so upset and couldn't find it anywhere. He looked in his desk, on the ground, but it was nowhere to be seen.

The teacher noticed the boy was sad, so she asked him what was wrong. He told her he had lost his pencil and was feeling very upset. The teacher was very kind and told the boy it was ok. She gave him a new pencil from her desk, and the boy was so happy.

He thanked the teacher for helping him, and for the rest of the day he stayed focused and did his work. He reminding himself to always keep his pencil close and never to forget it. He had learned an important lesson - that it was important never to lose something important again.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl. She was three years old and knew very few words. One day, she went out to explore the world. As she wandered around outside, she saw all the amazing things the season had to offer.

She saw the trees, which were very big. She ran around the grass, which was very green. She noticed that the flowers had many colors. She was so impressed by all the different things she was seeing.

Then, she stopped and asked her dad what all these things were. He told her that it was a new season and that everything she was seeing was very special. He also told her that each season was different and had something to offer.

The girl thought about what her dad had said. She looked around and started to understand why the season was so special. She started to understand why everything looked so impressive. She realized that each season was unique and offered something special to enjoy.

One day, Timmy was walking in his garden. He saw some delicious strawberries on a bush. Timmy wanted to pick them. He thought about it for a moment. 

He stepped closer to the bush, reached out his hand and grabbed a strawberry. It looked so juicy and delicious! 

Suddenly, Timmy heard a loud growl coming from behind him. He spun around and saw a big dog. It was looking straight at him with its big eyes. Timmy was in trouble.

Timmy thought about running away, but he was too scared. He just closed his eyes and waited. To his surprise, the dog began to lick his face. 

It turned out that the dog was friendly. Timmy petted it, picked the delicious strawberry and continued his walk around the garden.

Once there was a girl who was three years old. She was scared of the dark, but she wanted to peek at the big tree in the living room. She crept ever so softly so that no one would hear her. 

When she reached the tree she looked up and saw a beautiful ornament. It was so shiny and sparkly. She was scared to touch it, but could not resist its beauty. She reached up and grabbed it ever so carefully.  

The ornament was so light and felt nice in her hands. Suddenly, the lights turned on and the girl got scared. She quickly put back the ornament and ran out of the living room. She was so scared she never tried to peek at the tree again.

Once upon a time there was a little girl called Lucy. She was just 3 years old. One day she was playing in the garden when she scraped her knee. It hurt so much that she started to cry.

Mummy rushed outside and saw her. She put a dry bandage on Lucy's knee and it made it feel better. But then Mummy said to Lucy, "Now you must hide the bandage so that the doctor can't see it and make you wear a new one!" 

So, Lucy went and hid the bandage in her toy box. But she couldn't remember exactly where she had put it. After a few days of searching, Lucy finally found the dry bandage! Lucy and Mummy laughed, and Lucy put the bandage in a special safe place so she wouldn't forget it again.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl who found a big jewel. The jewel was very pretty and sparkled in the sun. She was so happy to find it! But then a bad man came by and took the jewel. He stole it from her and ran away.

The little girl was very upset. She knew she couldn't get her jewel back because the bad man was gone. She started to cry.

Her parents saw this and wanted to help. They went out to find the bad man and get the jewel back. After a while they found him, and they got the jewel back and gave it to the little girl.

The little girl was no longer upset. She was very happy to have the jewel back and thanked her parents for getting it back for her.

And that is the story of how the little girl got her magical jewel back. The end.

John was a big boy for three. He liked to do what his Dad did, so every day he would stare at his Dadâ€™s job. She did things with a computer and wrote things down. John thought it looked like fun.

One day, his Dad told him he should think about getting a job when he was older. He said it could be anything but that some jobs could be very competitive.

John didn't really know what â€˜competitiveâ€™ meant, so he asked lots of questions. His Dad said it meant that lots of people wanted the same job and so you had to be better than them to get it.

John thought about this a lot. He wanted to have a job one day that was fun and that lots of people wanted. He wanted it to be a special job.

So, every day, he would stare at his Dadâ€™s job and try to think of his own special job. Then he could be the best and get it!

Once there was a very smart bunny named Bun. He liked playing in the dark. One night, his mom told him it was bedtime, but Bun snuck out of bed. He grabbed his special toy, a little flashlight. He wanted to raise it up high and look around. He saw all kinds of things in the dark. He saw spiders and cats and he even saw a little mouse. Then he heard a noise. He was scared! He raiseed the flashlight up higher and saw it was his mom. She said "Bun, it's time to go to bed." Bun was so glad she was there. He raised the flashlight up to his face and smiled. And they both went back to bed.

Once upon a time, there were two friends, a bear and a rabbit. The two were best friends and were always together.
One day, they were walking through the woods when they came across a rough trap. The bear wanted to explore it, but the rabbit was scared and stayed back. The bear went closer to have a look and suddenly, he fell into the trap. 
The rabbit was so scared, he didn't know what to do. He felt so sad and he knew he couldn't help the bear by himself. He had to separate from the bear and find help. 
The rabbit was scared, but he ran and ran until he reached the house of an old wise owl. The wise owl thought for a bit and then said, "I have a way to help your friend".
He took the rabbit back to the trap and used a stick to lift the trap up. The two were soon reunited and were so happy to be together again.
They both thanked the wise old owl, and hugged each other tight before heading back home. They vowed to be more careful in the future, and always reminded each other to be extra careful around traps.

Once upon a time, there was a pumpkin that was sitting in a patch. It was very thick and round. He was happy to be living in the patch. 

Suddenly, the pumpkin heard a loud roar. He was scared and stayed very still. He didn't move until the roar stopped. 

When the roar stopped, the pumpkin looked around and saw a big lion. The lion had a giant mane around his neck. The lion was so big and strong! He was roaring to show everyone how strong he was. 

The pumpkin was very brave. He was not scared of the lion. He slowly stepped towards the lion and said, "Hello Lion! You are very brave to roar like that." 

The lion smiled and said, "Why thank you, Mr. Pumpkin! You are very brave too!" Then he said good-bye and walked away. 

The pumpkin was so happy and proud. He had made a new friend. He stood tall and proud in the patch and let out a mild roar to show everyone how brave he was.

Grandma wanted to decorate for the party. She got out a big box. Inside was a brilliant gun filled with stars. Grandma said it was for decorating. She asked me to help her put the stars on the walls. I was excited to do it. 

So I grabbed the gun, I held it close and started to shoot stars onto the walls. Grandma laughed and said I was doing a great job. When I was finished, the room was full of stars. It was so pretty and brilliant. 

Grandma gave me a hug and said that I was a brilliant decorator. I felt very proud. Then it was time for the party! All of my friends were surprised and excited to see the room filled with stars. We all had a really good time.

Once there was a little brown mouse. The mouse was very clever. He had a plan to get his favourite food.

He found a handle and he began to bite it. He bit the handle for a long time. Then it started to move and he was able to open the door.

Inside the room was full of food. The mouse ate lots of tasty treats. He was so happy and full.

But then he heard a noise. He saw a cat coming closer and closer. The mouse was quick and ran away. He had been very clever and got his food but he was lucky to escape the cat!

Once there was a bunny who loved to hop. Every day, the bunny hopped around the garden. He explored the flower beds, hopped across the paths and even hopped up onto the walls.

One day, the bunny spotted a big, bushy tree. He hopped closer and noticed all kinds of big and little spots on the tree's trunk. He hopped around the tree and found even more spots. The bunny was so busy counting all the spots that he didnâ€™t even notice the night time coming. 

The bunny was so happy in his new spot, he hopped around and looked for somewhere to sleep. He eventually found a cozy spot under the tree and curled up to rest until morning.

Once upon a time, there was a kind boy named Jack. He was very hungry, but he had no food.

Jack went to ask his mom for something to eat. She said, "I'm sorry Jack, but we don't have any food right now. I can get you something to drink." So Jack's mom gave him some special drink.

Jack drank the special drink, and he felt much better. He was still hungry, but his mom said he could have some food soon.

Jack's mom went to the store and brought back lots of yummy food. Jack was so happy! He ate the food and it was delicious.

Jack was very satisfied and content. He thanked his mom for the kind and tasty food.

Once upon a time there was a brave penny. She wanted to try something new, so she decided to go on an adventure. She hopped on her bicycle and started to speed away.

She pedalled faster and faster, zooming down the street. The wind swooshed through her hair. She felt so happy, and excited to see what lay ahead. 

Soon she came across a giant hill. She was a little scared, but she was brave. She kept pedalling as fast as she could; faster and faster she went up the hill. 

At the top, she stopped and looked around. The view was amazing! She felt so free and alive.

The brave penny smiled, feeling proud of herself. She knew she had been brave, and had accomplished something great. She sped back home, knowing that she had had a wonderful adventure.

Once upon a time, there was a wrap. It was orange and it was special.

Mommy went to the closet and put the wrap inside. Then she held the wrap up and told me to close my eyes.

When I opened them again, Mommy had put the wrap around me. It was so orange and warm and comfy. I smiled and laughed.

Mommy smiled too. She hugged me and said "You look just like a little present" Then she gave me a kiss.

I was so happy. I was wearing the orange wrap just like I wanted.

Once upon a time there was a little girl who was sad and lonely. She had no one to play with and no one to talk to. She began to feel so sad that she started to weep.

The little girl looked around for something that might cheer her up. Suddenly she spotted a tray of cookies sitting on the table. She smiled and grabbed a cookie. She ate the cookie and felt better.

Just then, she heard a noise coming from the corner of the room. It was a little mouse! The mouse was deaf and could not hear but she could see him. The little girl smiled and brought a mouse a cookie. The mouse was so happy that he ate the cookie and they became friends.

The little girl was no longer lonely. She had found a new friend. From then on, they played games together and shared the cookies. Whenever she felt sad, the mouse was always there to cheer her up. They were the best of friends.

Once there was a little girl who loved playing with her big brother. She was always amazed by the things he could do. One day, the brother was playing with a marble. He rolled it across the floor and watched it go.

The little girl wanted to play too, so she walked up to the marble and stared at it. She thought it was so amazing. She reached out her tiny hand and moved it from side to side.

Then, something amazing happened; the marble started to light up! All the colours in the room seemed to sparkle in the marble. The girl felt so excited that she couldn't help but smile and laugh.

The little girl and her brother spent the rest of the afternoon playing with the marble. They watched the colours twinkle and shine and the little girl was still amazed.

Once there was a little girl who loved to explore. She opened her bedroom door and saw a yellow carpet. It was so soft and squishy and she wanted to know where it came from. She followed it around the house and eventually she found it. It was in the living room and it was perfect. She wanted to keep it forever.

The little girl stepped onto the yellow carpet and immediately felt so warm and comfortable. She discovered that it was the most beautiful thing she had ever seen. She stopped and plopped down right in the middle of the cozy yellow carpet.

The girl spent hours playing on the carpet. She found all sorts of fun things to do like pretending she was a princess, rolling around, and making funny shapes. She even took her dolls there, and they had a great time, too!

The little girl's mom was so happy that she had found the yellow carpet. She said it was the perfect place for her daughter to play, relax and have fun. The girl loved it so much and she found that it was the best spot for her to explore her imagination.

Once upon a time, there was a deep green gate. It was very tall and strong, and it protected the garden from anything bad that might try to get in. 

One day, a little girl wanted to go into the garden. She wanted to see the flowers and trees and feel the sunshine. She tried to push the gate open, but it wouldn't move. It was too strong! 

Suddenly, she heard a gentle voice say, "Hello little one. To get into the garden, you must shut the gate." She looked around, but nobody was there. She tried pushing the gate open again, and this time it moved! 

The little girl ran into the garden, so excited to explore. Every day, she came back and shut the gate before she left.

After a while, the little girl was so big that she could no longer open the deep green gate. But whenever she saw it, she remembered all the adventures she had in the garden.

Once upon a time, there lived a green snake. He wanted some friends so he spread out to look for them. He spread through the grass, went into some bushes and even snuck under a pile of rocks. But the green snake couldn't find any friends.

Then he spread out a bit more, and then he saw something awesome! Two other snakes! They were a lot like him except one was red and one was blue. The green snake rushed over and said hello. 

The other two snakes were really happy to meet him. The three snakes began to play together, having all kinds of fun. All day long they spread around and chased each other, and in the evening they snuggled up together and slept.

The green snake had lots of fun with his new friends. They played together every day and the green snake was very happy to have them. The three friends will always be together and spread their joy!

Once upon a time, there was a lucky dish. It was made out of special sparkly metal and it was big and round and shiny. Everyone wanted the dish, but the dish refused to go to just anyone! It wanted to pick one special person who was very lucky.

Then one day, a little girl came along. She saw the dish sitting there and she wanted it. She asked the dish to come home with her and she promised to look after it forever. The dish looked at the little girl and decided she would be the one.

So the dish agreed to come to the girl's house. Together they went and the girl was so excited and happy! She carried the dish all the way home and never refused to give it away. The dish was now lucky to have such a special home with the girl.

One day, Jim was playing a game. He wanted to win! He used his machine. It was big and looked very dull. He worked really hard to get the machine to do what he wanted. Then he heard something amazing! He had won! Everyone cheered for Jim for winning with his machine. Jim was so happy he wanted to do it again. He raced to the machine and started playing the game. He wanted to win again! After much trying, he was able to win again! Now, Jim was the happiest he had been in a long time. The machine was the best!

Once upon a time, there was a shy little girl who loved to paint. One day, she was walking through the park when she saw something shiny in the grass - it was an axe! She had never seen a real axe before, and she was both curious and scared about it. 

The little girl slowly walked over to the axe and knelt down beside it. She picked it up and turned it gently in her hands, admiring its sleek metal shape. She was so mesmerised by the axe that she decided to paint it. 

She went back home to get her paints and brushes and went to her special spot in the park. She mixed the paints together carefully, creating the perfect colours to paint the axe. She then slowly and carefully painted the axe with her favourite colours, the bright blues and yellows blending together like magic. 

When she finished painting the axe, the little girl was very proud of her work. She twirled around with joy, feeling brave and creative. From that day forward, the little girl was never shy about painting!

Once there was a cool spider who lived in a nice cave. Every day she would explore the cave, looking for something new to find. But sometimes the spider found that other creatures would ignore her.

She decided to try something new to make them pay attention. She spun a giant, beautiful web. She was so proud of the web that she wanted everyone to look at it. But still, the other creatures chose to ignore her.

But one day, the spider had an idea. She jumped on top of her web, and started to wiggle her legs and sing a happy song. Now the other creatures stopped ignoring her and watched in awe. 

The spider found this to be so much fun that she returned every day to sing her happy song. Now all the animals admired her and clapped along to her singing. She was proud to have such cool friends who wouldn't ignore her anymore.

Once upon a time there was a little girl named Lucy.

Lucy was a very miserable girl. She thought her life was unfair. Every day she was sad, and never smiled.

One day, Lucy was walking by a bakery and smelled something good. It was a pastry! Lucy felt so happy that she could almost smile.

But then Lucy remembered that she didn't have any money with her. She felt so sad and alone. She thought she would never get to have a pastry.

Suddenly, the bakery owner opened the door and handed her a pastry. He said he wanted Lucy to be happy again.

Lucy was so happy. She smiled and thanked the kind bakery owner. She took a big bite of the pastry and thought about how nice it was to get a special treat.

Once upon a time, there were two friends. They were both happy and liked to play together. One day they wanted to do something special so they invited their friends to join them. Soon, a big group of happy friends had gathered.

The friends liked to hug and they all gave each other big hugs. The group was so happy. But then they noticed someone far away looking lonely. They wanted to make the person feel better so they decided to give him a big hug too. 

They all ran towards him and hugged him. He was very surprised and began to smile. He felt so happy to be part of the group.

From that day on, the group was even closer and happier. They would always remember to reach out to the people who felt distant and offer them a big hug.

Once upon a time, there was a little rabbit. He was so lonely living all by himself! He wanted to make some friends, but he wasn't sure how.

One day he had an idea. He saw a cable lying nearby and he thought he could use it to zip around and find some friends. So he grabbed the cable and zipped off.

Pretty soon the little rabbit found a group of other rabbits. They were so happy to meet him! They all talked and ran about, and had a great time.

The little rabbit was so happy now that he had friends. From that day on, he made sure to always keep his cable with him, just in case he ever felt lonely again.

Once there was a little girl called Lucy. She lived in a house full of amazing things. Every day she explored her house and discovered something new.

One day, Lucy found a cherry tree in her garden. She saw the cherry tree had lots of sweet, red fruits. She didn't know what it was, so she asked her mother.

Her mum said, "That is a cherry tree. Do you want to try one of the cherries?"

Lucy was so excited. She plucked a juicy cherry off the tree and ate it. It was the most amazing thing she had ever tasted. She knew she loved cherries and wanted to eat them every day. 

Mum said, "Cherries are very special, so we won't pick them all. We will just pick a few, so that the cherry tree can grow lots more fruit."

So every day Lucy would head out into the garden, pick one or two cherries, then she'd run inside and enjoy a delicious snack. She knew that cherries were amazing and always looked forward to picking them.

Once upon a time, there was a boy who wanted to hang with his friends. He asked Mum if he could go outside and play. Mum said he could go, but he had to be safe. So, the boy ran out with his friends and had lots of fun. 

They played for a long time, until the boy's friends said it was time to go home. Before they left, the friends gave the boy a pass to come back again the next day. 

The boy was happy he could hang with his friends again and ran home with the pass safely in his pocket. Every day, he would hang with his friends and have lots of fun. 

The End.

Once upon a time there was a girl named Flossy. Flossy was three years old and she was very curious. One day she was in her dad's wardrobe and she found a pair of sunglasses. She had never seen these before and she felt very curious. She wanted to know what they were. She carefully tried them on and saw the world around her in a different way. 

Suddenly Flossy saw something disgusting on the ground. It was a big gooey bug! Flossy was so scared and she quickly put the sunglasses away and ran out of the wardrobe. She knew she had to tell her dad about the bug. 

When dad heard the news he put on his sunglasses and went to inspect. Sure enough, the bug was still there and he quickly got rid of it. After that Flossy never put on the sunglasses again. She knew that she'd been very lucky that day and she never wanted to find something disgusting ever again!

Once upon a time, there was a girl named Jane who had a pet. It was a furry dog called Rusty. Every morning, Jane would wake up early and play with Rusty in the backyard.

She would whisper to him and tell him lots of stories. Rusty always seemed to understand and listen eagerly. Jane would then make sure he was ready for their daily walk around the block before they had breakfast.

Sometimes, Jane would get so excited shouting and playing with Rusty, that he would bark out loud. But when it was time for her to go inside for dinner, she would just whisper to him softly because she knew he always liked that. He would lay his head on his paws and listen intently to her until she finished. It was the perfect way to end the day.

Once upon a time, there was a generous lady who had an important job. Her job was to remind the people in her town to be kind. She helped people who were in jail and made sure they had enough to eat. She always gave them a big smile when she visited.

One day, the generous lady decided she wanted to do something more for the people in jail. She went to the local store and bought lots of treats. Then she went back to the jail and shared them out. Everyone was so happy and thanked her. 

The generous lady's job was to remind them to be kind, but she was also reminding them of how good it is to be generous. Her generous actions made the people in jail feel good, and the people in town very proud. 

At the end of the day, the generous lady smiled. She was happy that she could help make people's day a little brighter.

One day, a hunter was walking through the forest. He was looking for something to bring back home. Suddenly, he heard a noise in the bushes. He stopped to listen. It sounded like something was in trouble.

The hunter saw a little bunny tangled in a bush. He carefully took the bunny out of the bush and held it in his hands. The bunny was embarrassed, but the hunter was very kind. He talked to the bunny and made it feel safe.

The hunter brought the bunny back home with him. He hugged the bunny tight and got it some food. He made sure it was happy and comfortable. The bunny was so grateful that the hunter came along and saved it. 

After that, the hunter and the bunny were best friends. The hunter would often bring food for the bunny and take long walks together. They were never embarrassed when they were together. They were happy to be friends forever.

John was a cool kid who liked to explore. One day he was with his mom in the big building and saw an elevator. It looked like a metal box and he wondered what it was. Mom explained that it was an elevator and it could take people to different floors of the building. John was excited and wanted to try it out. 

John and his mom got in the elevator. He felt the floor move under his feet and it made him giggle. He was amazed at how the elevator could take them so high up so quickly. When they got to their floor, John was so proud that he knew how to ride the elevator. He told his mom that he was cool!

John was really glad he knew how to use the elevator. He was proud that he could show his mom that he knew how to use it too. Whenever they go to the big building now, John likes to ride the elevator all by himself. His mom is still there to make sure he is safe, but he knows how to use it just by himself.

Once upon a time, there was a great sunrise. The sky was bright and beautiful. All the birds sang happily. Then, something special happened. A tiny little bunny came out of the trees and lay down in the grass. She wanted to watch the sunrise get brighter and brighter. She watched and watched until the sky was orange, yellow and pink. It was a great sunrise.

Suddenly, a cloud covered the sun. The bunny could not see the sunrise anymore. She lay in the grass and thought. Then, she had an idea. She curled up into a ball and pretended to lie like the sun.

It was a great moment. She was the little sun! All the birds came closer to see her and chirp in delight. She lay there until the sky was bright again. And, when the sky was bright again, the real sun came out from behind the cloud. 

The little bunny watched the sunrise with delight. And, in that moment, she was part of the sunrise too. She lay in the grass and watched until the sky was blue. Then, she hopped away. It was a great sunrise.

Once upon a time there was a big, round thing called Earth. It was very interesting and included lots of things.

The Earth had green grass, bright blue sky, fluffy clouds, and naughty bugs. There were big birds that flew high in the sky and funny fish that swam in the oceans.

The Earth had people who lived on it too. Some people had beds to sleep in, and some people had sweaters to keep them warm. Some people ate ice cream, and some people ate pizza.

The Earth was a very special place with lots of things for people to see and do. From time to time people visited the Earth from other places and joined in the fun. 

The Earth was full of interesting things and everyone liked it very much.

Once there was a little boy named Joe. He wanted to create something fun. So with his daddy, he went to a store. It sold lots of things, like navy paint. Joe wanted to paint something special, but the paint was too expensive. He saw some cheap navy paint and asked his dad to buy it.

Joe painted his old toy car with the navy paint. He made it look like a navy car. He felt so proud of it and showed it to everyone. Joe thought his new navy car was the best!

Joe's dad was proud of him for using his imaginations to create something fun. Joe and his dad were so happy that Joe got to create something with the cheap navy paint!

Once upon a time there was a quiet little girl called Zoe. Zoe's mum was a teacher and she had to travel across the world to supply books to schools. Zoe didn't know about it until the day her mum packed a suitcase and showed Zoe her passport. It was big and blue.

Zoe got really excited and said she wanted to come too. But her mum said it was only for grown-ups and they were going to be very busy. So Zoe stayed at home with her Grandma. Every day she filled out an activity book and wrote a letter to her mum.

At the end of the adventure, her mum arrived safely home with lots of stories to tell. She gave Zoe a very special present: a world map. Together, they pointed to all the places her mum had been. As they chattered away, Zoe felt proud of her mum and all the supplies she had sent across the world.

Once upon a time there was a lucky horn. The horn was very shiny and colourful. One day a little boy named Jack stumbled across the horn. He picked it up and blew it. As he blew the horn, he wished for luck.

Suddenly, an enormous rabbit appeared. It was bigger than Jack and hopped around him in excitement. The rabbit told Jack that the horn was a magical lucky horn and that with it he would always remain lucky.

Jack thanked the rabbit and decided to take the lucky horn with him on his adventures. Everywhere Jack went, he was lucky. He remained luckier than ever!

The end.

Once there was an ancient man. He lived in a small house in the forest. Every day he would take long walks and look for mushrooms. One day he spotted a mushroom at noon that looked very special. He wanted to pick the mushroom but it was very hard. He pushed and pulled for a long time, but it wouldn't yield. The ancient man started to worry, but he didn't give up. He worked and worked, and finally after a lot of effort the mushroom yielded. The man was very happy. He brought the mushroom home and then cooked it. It was the best mushroom he had ever tasted!

Once upon a time, there was a big, lazy octopus. It lived in a big box, filled with fun things to play with. Everyday, the octopus would reach in and pull out a surprise. One day, the octopus heard a noise coming from outside the box. It saw some people carrying it away from its home.

The octopus was afraid, but it soon realized that the people were actually helping it. The people unpacked the box and set the octopus free. The octopus felt excited! It was so happy to finally explore all the new places around it.

The octopus happily spent the day exploring and playing. As it watched the sunset, the octopus felt so content and relaxed. It went to its special spot and watched as the stars twinkled in the night sky.

The lazy octopus was so thankful to the people who unpacked it and gave it a chance to explore the world. The octopus gave them a big, sticky hug and said thank you.

Once upon a time there was a little girl named Sam. She had a drum that she loved to play. One day, her brother and her started to quarrel. They shouted, screamed and banged the drum!

The noise was so loud that their mum came to see what was happening. She scolded them and told them to stop, but they just kept on quarreling.

Mum had an idea. She said they should play the drum together, and make a happy sound.

So they did! They banged the drum in a lively way and made a beautiful, lively sound. The quarreling stopped and they heard the sound of happiness. 

They smiled and mum was happy, too. They all enjoyed the sound of the drum and made wonderful music together.

The boy was very glad. He was going for a walk by the creek. He had his recorder with him. He was so excited!

He stopped in one spot and looked around. He heard the birds chirping in the trees and the water lapping against the creek's banks. He listened to the sounds and then started to record them.

He played back the recording to see how it sounded. He couldn't believe how it sounded; it was like he was really there! He recorded some more sounds, and then he decided to walk a little further. He was very glad.

As he walked, he recorded the sounds of the creek, the bird's chirps and the rustling of the leaves in the wind. He was so happy, he kept on recording until his recorder ran out of batteries.

But even after his recorder ran out of power, he still remembered the wonderful sounds of nature. He was so glad that he got to record it all.

Once there was a little boy called Sam who was very excited about his first visit to the golf course. His Grandad had brought him to see all the amazing things he could do there.

Sam was shocked when he saw the size of the golf course. It seemed to stretch on forever, with all kinds of paths he had never seen before. But Grandad warned him that he must not go off exploring on his own.

So they stayed together, walking up and down the green paths and looking at all the different trees and plants. They watched some people playing golf and Grandad told Sam how it works.

When it was time to go home, Grandad warned Sam not to forget what they had learnt today so they can come back again soon. Sam nodded and smiled because he was very excited to come back soon and learn more about golf.

Once upon a time there was a little girl. She saw a big gorilla. She wanted to pet it but her mommy would not let her. Mommy said it was too dangerous. The gorilla was fake. 

So the girl went to find another gorilla. At the park, she saw a fake gorilla. It was big and furry. She wanted to hug it, but her mommy said no. Mommy said that it was not safe to hug fake animals. 

The girl and mommy kept walking and soon, they found a real gorilla! The little girl wanted to touch the gorilla, but the zookeeper said no. He said it was dangerous and he was there to prevent the girl from getting too close. 

The girl was disappointed, but her mommy said it was all for the best. She hugged the little girl and said that it would be safer to look at the gorilla from far away. The girl smiled and enjoyed watching the gorilla from a safe distance.

Once there was a little boy who was very excited. He was so excited, he wanted to show everyone his new toy. Suddenly, a thief came and tried to take it away. The little boy was so embarrassed. He yelled for help, and soon his dad came running into the room. Dad saw the thief and quickly took the toy back. He scolded the thief and the thief ran away. 

The little boy felt so relieved and hugged his dad. Everyone else in the room was so proud of him, they clapped and cheered! The little boy was relieved and excited all over again. He knew he had done the right thing and felt much better.

Once upon a time, there were two bears called Jenna and David. Jenna and David were usually very happy, but today they were quarreling. Jenna wanted to draw a lovely picture but David wanted to print a special book. They both felt very confused by their different ideas.

Suddenly, Jenna had an idea! She suggested they both draw a picture together. David was delighted and agreed straight away. The two bears started colouring and drawing and in the end they created a beautiful picture. Jenna and David smiled at each other.

The two friends hugged and promised to never quarrel again. Whenever they had a new idea, they would share it together so that they wouldnâ€™t get confused. Jenna and David learnt a valuable lesson that day that would help them for many years.

Sarah was packing her house. She had to move to a new place, but she was very excited. She gathered up all her things and made them easy to carry. She put her books, pencils, clothes, and dolls into bags. She packed up her bed and the chairs too. Finally, everything was ready to go. She grabbed the bags and said goodbye to her house. She was excited to see her new home!

Once there was a little boy who was playing with his toys. He was very happy playing and laughing. Suddenly, he looked out the window and saw a big truck rolling down the street. It had a big pile of coal in the back. Suddenly, the little boy began to panic. He knew that coal was expensive and he didn't understand why there was so much of it.

The little boy decided to go outside and see the truck. When he got outside he saw that the truck was stopped at his house! He was very scared and he started to panic more. He went down the street to ask his neighbour what was happening.

His neighbour told him that the truck was bringing coal to his house. She said that it was going to be very expensive and that his house was going to be very warm soon. The little boy was still scared but he understood. He thanked his neighbour and ran back home. 

When he arrived home, he saw that the truck had already unloaded the coal. His family was putting the coal inside the house. He felt better and he smiled. He knew his house was going to be warm and special now. He knew he didn't have to panic anymore.

Once there was a little girl named Jane. She loved to spend time outside looking at the world around her. Today, she was going to go down to the river to have a bath.

When she got there, Jane gasped with delight. The river was so beautiful, with sparkling water and colourful fish swimming around. She couldn't wait to jump in.

Jane took off her clothes and started to bathe in the river. All around her, the cool water tickled her skin and she felt so light and free. She laughed and splashed around, having the best time.

But then, the river got dull. The sparkles had gone and the fish began to swim away. Suddenly, Jane was scared and wanted to get out. She ran as fast back to the bank and got dressed.

When she was all done, Jane packed up her things and headed home. The river was still dull, but she promised to go back another day and try again.

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Jack. He was very busy. Jack wanted to go to the beach to play in the sand. He also wanted to get some shrimp.

When Jack got to the beach, he was so excited. He started to make a sandcastle. He worked hard to make it perfect.

While Jack was busy building his sandcastle, he found some little shrimp. He picked one up to look at it. It was so funny! He needed to get more shrimp so that he could play with them.

Jack looked all around the beach for another shrimp. Finally, he found what he needed. He was so happy to have found two shrimp. He quickly put them in a bucket and ran off to have some fun.

Jack spent the whole day playing with his two shrimp. He had so much fun! He wasn't busy anymore.  By the end of the day, Jack was tired but he was also very happy.

Once upon a time, there lived a strong rabbit. He had big, strong muscles. He loved to run and slide.

One day, the rabbit wanted to see how far he could run. He ran and ran for a long time. He was so happy that he was getting faster and faster.

Suddenly, the rabbit paused. He could see something deep in the woods. He wanted to explore, but he was scared. He stood still for a long time, trying to find the courage to go in.

Finally, he took a deep breath and ran into the woods. He ran for what seemed like forever. He hopped around, looking for something special. And then, he saw it! He had found a magical pond! 

The bunny smiled, feeling happy and free. He hopped around the pond, enjoying the beautiful view. He laughed, feeling strong and brave. He would always remember that magical day.

Once upon a time there was an intelligent bear. One day, he was walking in the forest when he came across a big, tall cliff. He thought it would be fun to climb it, so he started to climb up. But, when he was almost at the top came the rain. He was so wet that he had to close his eyes and hold tight as he slipped and slid down the cliff.

When he was almost at the bottom, he saw a cave. He was so happy that he could go inside and stay dry. But the cave was closed! The bear was so smart that he figured out the way to open it. He used a big rock and pushed it in the door. It opened and he went inside.

Now, the bear is safe from the rain and he is so happy. Because he was an intelligent bear he was able to open the cave and find a safe place to stay. The end!

Once upon a time, there was an attractive valley. It was a lovely place - the grass was green, the flowers were bright, and the sun shone down with a warm, happy light.

One day, a group of children decided to go and explore the valley. They saw lots of animals and knew they would have an exciting day.

The children brought a picnic lunch and shared it with some of the animals they saw. They had lots of fun together in the valley.

But when it got dark, the children had to go home - but not before bringing a few friends with them. They had made friends with some of the animals in the attractive valley, and wanted to take them home with them. So the children filled their pockets with cute little friends, and off they went.

They had a wonderful day, and were so happy to bring some of the valley's animals home with them.

Once, there was a fisherman who went out to the sea to catch fish. As he sailed, he felt the water hit his face and the sun warming his skin. Suddenly, the wind changed and the boat started to move quickly. The fisherman felt a bit dizzy.

He looked around and spotted a small island. He decided to go ashore and take a rest. He was very lucky because he saw a lot of fish swimming around! The fisherman jumped in the water and started to catch them with his hands. He was able to get a lot of fish!

When the fisherman came back to the boat, he felt very thankful. He thanked the wind, the water, and the fish for helping him. He brought the fish back to the shore and sold them for a lot of money. The fisherman was so happy!

One day, two boys were out searching for something special. They ran through the garden, over the bridge and around the trees, but nothing seemed special enough. Suddenly one of the boys noticed something shiny in the grass. He bent down and picked up a shining strip that sparkled in the sunshine.

The two boys grinned at each other. They had found something very popular! Taking the strip, they ran back and showed it proudly to all their friends. Everyone oohed and ahhed at the beautiful strip and it became the boys' most prized possession.

The boys searched everywhere they went and took the strip whenever they went on an adventure. Everywhere they went, their strip was the most popular!

Once upon a time, there was a little girl who was very obedient. Every day she would do her chores and always listen to her mum. One day, the little girl saw two boys fighting over an object. The boys were very angry and shouting at each other. She felt sad for them and wanted them to stop fighting. So, she took the object from them, and showed it to the boys. The object was very special and the boys wanted to keep it. But instead of fighting, they decided to share it. Seeing this, the little girl smiled and was very proud of them. The boys thanked her and they all went home, happy and content. The end.

Once upon a time, there was an incredible automobile. It had shiny wheels and a loud engine. Everyone who saw it said it was so cool.

One day, the little car was parked in the driveway. Suddenly, a big gust of wind started to blow. The wind was so powerful, it made the car shake. Suddenly, one of the wheels came off and flew away!

The little car was sad because it couldn't go anymore. It felt like it was broken. But then something amazing happened. A friendly fairy flew down from the sky!

The fairy had a magical spell. She used it to make the car brand new again. She waved her wand twice and the wheel came back! The little car was so happy, it started to tear.

Once there was a family who had two children, a brother and a sister. The brother and the sister would often disagree on things. One day their mom said they needed to get water from the well. The brother wanted to compete and race to see who could get the water from the well first. The sister did not like this idea. She wanted to take turns and go together. They got very competitive discussing what to do, but eventually agreed to take turns. So the brother and the sister took turns going to the well and returning with water for the family. They both had fun and learned that everyone could be happy when they disagree.

One day, a woman was walking in the park. Her eyes sparkled as she saw a brown bird in the tree. She smiled and laughed. Then, she went to the playground to laugh again. She saw a little boy laughing on the swings. She laughed too. Soon they were both laughing and having a good time.

The woman then saw a brown snake on the ground. She stepped back and gasped, but then she started laughing again. It was just a stick! She laughed and picked it up. The little boy laughed too. They both laughed until their bellies hurt. 

The woman and the little boy went home together. Wherever the woman went, she found something to laugh about. She was so happy and all the day she was heard laughing.

Once upon a time there was a very careless fork. He wanted to serve his friends, but he was so careless that he always dropped the food on the floor. He was very sad, because he knew that his friends would feel bad if they didn't get their food.

One day his friends asked him to serve them a special dinner. The fork took a deep breath and tried his very best not to be careless. He was very careful as he brought the food to his friends. Everyone smiled and thanked him for his work.

The careless fork was so happy that he had been able to serve his friends. He promised himself to be more careful in the future. Since then, he serves his friends their meals with great care. And they are very thankful to him!

Once upon a time, a boy named Jack was sitting at the kitchen table with his mother. His mom put a spoon in front of him and said, "Jack, this spoon is for you." It was a shiny silver spoon, and Jack liked it a lot.

He took the spoon and stirred it around in a big bowl. The bowl was full of a nasty, bitter soup. Jack wrinkled up his nose, he did not like the smell of the soup. His mom said to him, "Jack, try to eat some of the soup. It might be nasty, but it's good for you."

Jack started to eat the soup with his spoon. It was very bitter, and Jack didn't like it much. He kept eating it though, because his mom asked him too. When Jack finished his soup, he wiped his mouth and said, "Mom, that soup was really bitter!" His mother smiled and said, "I know, Jack. But you ate it all, and that's what's important."

Once upon a time, there was a nice boy. One day, he wanted to do something special. So he went to the store and bought a flag. 

He went outside and found an empty field. He smiled and put the flag in the middle. Then he invited all his friends to come over and play in the empty field. 

All his friends ran over to join him. They began to play tag and have fun. Soon enough, it was time to go home. 

Before they left, they thanked the boy for inviting them. He smiled and waved goodbye to his friends with the flag in his hand. 

The little boy was very happy. He couldn't wait to invite his friends to play with him again.

Once upon a time, there were two friends, Max and Jack. Max was very envious of the special tea that Jack had. So one day, he asked Jack if he could have some of his tea. Jack hesitated for a moment and then said yes. 

Max was so excited! He grabbed the tea and ran away, wanting to try it before Jack changed his mind. He drank the tea, and it was delicious! 

Suddenly, he started to feel strange and realized that he was starting to disappear. He waved goodbye to Jack, but it was too late. He had disappeared completely! 

Jack was surprised - he had never seen anyone disappear before! He was sad that Max had gone, but he was also relieved that he still had his special tea. 

From then on, Jack kept his tea a secret so that no one else could take it away. And Max was never seen again!

Mommy was in the kitchen. She wanted to cook a special dinner. She had a dependable recipe and the ingredients were lined up on the counter. One of the ingredients was pink. Mommy mixed it all together and put it in the oven.

Mommy and the little one watched and waited. Soon, a delicious smell filled the kitchen. Mommy took out the dish and placed it on the table. It was a beautiful pink casserole.

The little one tasted it. It was so yummy! Mommy smiled and said, "See, I told you I could cook something special." Even though she was dependable, the little one could see Mommy was surprised how delicious it was. 

From that day on, the little one knew that Mommy was dependable and could cook something yummy anytime.

Once there was a grumpy bear. He was always sad and lonely. He had no one to talk to and no one to play with.

One day, a letter arrived for the bear. It was from a wise old owl who wanted to help the bear. The letter told the bear to come to the old forest to be healed.

The bear was excited! He said goodbye to his house and set off on his journey to the old forest.

When he arrived, he found the old owl who told him that if he wanted to be healed, he must be gentle, kind and patient with the animals of the forest. The bear followed these instructions and soon he noticed that he felt better inside. He was healing!

The bear stayed in the old forest for many days. He made friends with the other animals, played with them and had lots of fun. Eventually the bear was so happy, he decided it was time to go home.

He said goodbye to the old owl, thanked him for the letter and left the old forest, fully healed!

Once upon a time, there was a nice girl called Amy. One day, Amy was playing in the garden and she saw a puddle. She wanted to jump in it, so she took off her shoes and socks and she stepped into the puddle.

Luke was a little boy who really liked to jump. He ran up to the playground every day to play with all the other kids. One day when Luke was playing in the playground, he noticed a big scary spike in the middle of the ground. He felt scared, so he started to run away from it.

The other kids noticed him running away, so they all ran towards the spike. They wanted to jump over it! But then one of the children said he wanted to jump first. He was being selfish and didn't want to share.

Luke took a deep breath and decided that he wanted to jump over the spike too. He was feeling brave. He started running and jumped as high as he could. He made it over the spike!

The other kids cheered and clapped. Luke felt proud of himself. Now he didn't feel scared of the spike anymore. He was jumping higher and higher every day!

Jamie was a cheerful 3 year old girl who liked to bake with her mom. Every morning, they would go to the kitchen and get the ingredients they needed. Jamie would mix the flour, sugar and eggs while mom prepared the pans and preheated the oven. Then they would pour the mix into the pans and bake the port together.  

When the port was done, mom and Jamie took it out of the oven. The sweet smell of freshly baked port filled the house and made Jamie's tummy rumble. She couldn't wait to try it! 

Jamie and her mom put the port on a plate and added some butter, jam and cream. Then they sat down for breakfast with dad. Jamie took one bite and smiled. The port was delicious! Then she took another big bite and kept smiling.

One day, a little boy went outside with his mommy for a walk. He saw birds flying in the sky and wanted to get closer. His mommy nodded and picked him up. She carried him to a nearby park where they could watch the birds up close. It was lots of fun! The little boy saw the birds hopping from branch to branch and he laughed with joy.

He wanted to try it too, so he asked his mommy to lift him up. She nodded and picked him up to a branch. The little boy sat on the branch and felt how easy it was to balance there. He laughed with delight and hopped from branch to branch, just like the birds. He was having so much fun! 

His mommy smiled as she watched her little boy explore. She was glad he was having an easy and fun time being active outdoors. They stayed in the park until the sun started to set. Then, they went home together.

One day, a boy named Matt was in his room. He saw his chair, and he liked it very much. He wanted it to be even better than it was.

So, Matt tried to find a way to improve it. He thought and he thought, but nothing came to mind.

Suddenly, Matt had an idea. He ran to the kitchen and got some paint. Then, he brought it back to his room and painted the chair with a fine, bright color.

When he was done, the chair looked much better! Matt was so happy with it. He jumped up and down and clapped his hands. He loved how his chair looked now.

Molly was a 3 year old girl. She was very pleased one day when she saw a toy in the store window. She asked her parents if she could have it. They said yes and Molly was very glad.

Inside the store, Molly hugged the toy tightly. She couldn't wait to go home and play with it. But as they were leaving, the toy got caught in something and broke. Molly frowned sadly.

The store owner saw what happened. He came out and gave Molly a bigger and better toy. Molly was so happy and smiled with delight. She thanked the shopkeeper and hugged her new toy.

Molly went home with her new toy. She was very glad and couldn't wait to start playing with it. She promised to take extra good care of it this time.

Once there was a little girl called Lily. She heard a strange noise coming from outside her door. She got up from her bed and walked to the door with her teddy bear in her hand. She opened the door, and saw her nosy neighbour looking in. Lily was surprised and let out a big sigh.

The neighbour said hello and asked Lily if she was ok. Lily said yes but she was unsure why the neighbour was looking in her window. She asked the neighbour why they were being nosy.

The neighbour said they just wanted to make sure Lily was safe. Lily thanked the neighbour and closed the door. She went back to her room, feeling happy that someone was looking out for her.

Tony yawned. He was feeling so tired and sleepy. His favorite thing to do when he was feeling this way was to ride his bike!

Tony pushed his bike to the street and he hopped on the seat. He grabbed the handlebars and he quickly pushed on the pedals. His chubby little legs squeezed the pedals quickly and he zoomed away. 

He loved to feel the wind as it blew his hair and he laughed as he peddled faster and faster. Tony rode his bike until it was time to go home to bed.

He yawned and pedaled slowly back to his house. Tony was so tired that he almost fell off his bike a few times. When he finally got home he felt just a little bit better and hopped off his bike and went inside to sleep.

Once upon a time there was a swan who had an incredible mission. She floated through the water looking for something special. When she finally found it she was so proud. She had found a big sack. The swan knew she had to get the sack home so she grabbed it in her beak and flew off. 

The swan flew high in the air until she arrived home. She landed in the lake and gently put down the big sack. The swan was so excited she danced around the sack and sang. All the other animals in the lake were amazed. 

The swan opened the sack and inside was a surprise for everyone. It was full of vegetables, fruit and seeds! The swan had gone on an incredible mission and brought back treasure for everyone. Everyone was really happy and thanked the swan for her hard work.

Once upon a time, there was a bunny who loved to have fun. One day, the bunny wanted to play with his friends, so he hopped along the forest path to find them. But it was very foggy and the bunny couldn't see. He started to worry, but then he remembered that he had something with him that he could use. He looked at his backpack and smiled, because he remembered that he had a mist in there. He opened the bag and pulled out the mist. He used it to make it so that he could see his way.

The bunny was so happy! He was able to find his friends, and soon they were all having a great time playing together. The mist was very useful, and the bunny was glad he remembered to bring it along. He made sure to keep the mist in his bag, so he could use it whenever he needed to find his way in the fog. He was very thankful for his mist!
